CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff Liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff Liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff Liaison

  Wednesday, April 16, 2025 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst

  2. PRESENTATIONS –Parks and Recreation Master Plan

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – March 19, 2025

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program – Armando Cisneros
  b. Bingo Report – George Borst
  c. Account Balance Update – Armando Cisneros
  d. Monthly Senior Program Fees – Armando Cisneros
  e. Mt. SAC Classes Update- Armando Cisneros
  f. Aging Next – Armando Cisneros
  g. Facilities Report – Yvonne Duran
  h. Upcoming Events – Robyn Olsen

  5. PUBLIC COMMENT
   Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 a.m. on May 21st at the La Verne Community Center, 3680 D Street, La Verne CA
  91750.

Posting Statement: On April 10, 2025 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted on the
bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
www.cityoflaverne.org
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, April 16, 2025

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, April 16, 2025.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst,
  Jenny Jolly, Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: None.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Director of Community Services, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community
  Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Bette Donovan and seconded by Scott Snider to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, March 19, 2025 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Representatives from the La Verne Parks and Recreation Master
  Plan, Nicole Houston and Joe Punsalan provided updates on the data collected to
  date. It included the importance of a master plan and the need to observed and
  researched improvements necessary to maintain and enhance the existing city
  parks and facilities as the demographics and trends change. The plan may be
  found on the cityoflaverne.org site. They also ask to respond to a survey found at
  LaVerneSurvey.org/open.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 580 meals were served to an average of 26 participants in
  April.

  Meals on Wheels: N/A.

4. Bingo Report: Bingo receipts totaled $8,405.00. Ending balance in the
  account through March was $1,205.00 after $7,200 in payouts and expenses.
  Liabilities to Bingo West were $674.00. Liabilities to the City of La Verne,
  $534.00. The number of players in attendance for the month of March: 273.

5. Account Balance: $4,076.41.
 6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Spring session began on Monday, February 24. Registration for
  Summer/Fall 2025 will be on Tuesday, May 27 from 10:30AM-12:30PM.

8. Aging Next: 10 La Verne Residents were served in April. 9 was served via the
  Joslyn Center and 1 served via the Aging Next office.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: The Senior Craft Room roof was checked for other possible
  areas that might leak. Veterans Hall will be adding new statues that will be
  revealed on Memorial Day.

10. Upcoming Events

  •  Saturday, April 19th – Senior Craft Fair, 9:00AM-3:00PM.
  •  Tuesday, April 22nd– Excursion: Carlsbad Flower Fields and Premium Outlets, 8:00AM-
  5:00PM.
  •  Friday, April 25th – Senior Volunteer Luncheon: Roots of Recognition, 10:00AM-12:45PM.
  •  Sunday May 4th – Senior Dinner Dance: Midnight in Paris, 4:00PM-7:00PM.
  •  Wednesday, May 7th - Senior Seminar: Healthy Living for Your Brain and Body, Tips from the
  Latest Research-YWCA, 9:30AM.
  •  Monday, May 12th - Movie Matinee: The Intern, 12:30PM.
  •  Saturday, May 17th- Excursion: Catalina Island, 8:00 AM- 8:30 PM

  Public Comments: George Borst informed the committee of a rise in the number of
  Bingo participants due to some new people from West Covina attending. Bette
  mentioned that the craft fair information was shared on Facebook through one of
  the groups she is part of.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 11:06AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, May 21, 2025 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
